purpose: Guide deliberate, visible variation in future Capital Empire art assets. Preserve each asset family's identity and game art style.

treeVariants.direction: Airy crown with exposed branch channels; small separated leaf or needle clusters.
Asymmetric coverage; some limbs leafy and others bare; unevenly distributed clusters.
Mostly exposed branch and twig network with only scattered living foliage. Preserve actual transparent gaps.
Fuller than the other variants but still broken into clusters with visible gaps; retain original dense v1 as the lush end of the range.

futureAssetRules: Define the meaningful difference for every slot before generation; do not ask only for 'four variations'.
For trees vary foliage coverage, cluster size and distribution, branch architecture, canopy silhouette, maturity, and restrained within-species color accents.
Keep species, season, projection, lighting direction and painted texture consistent within each family.
Use natural asymmetry; avoid mirrored duplicates or merely scaling one design.
Judge variation at actual map scale: each variant must read differently when reduced to a small sprite.
Require true transparent spaces between exposed branches; reject opaque grey/brown canopy backdrops, detached noise, clipped crowns, cropped roots and overlapping subjects.
Generate no more than four subjects per sheet, with generous outer and center margins; inspect and slice each actual silhouette rather than assuming equal cells.
Preserve full alpha and record native dimensions, source crop and proposed trunk-base anchor. Set world scale during integration.
targetsAreArtDirection: Coverage percentages in prompts are approximate direction, not measured output properties.
